summary: Combined backend + frontend round for the new CameraCapture component and the Bahasa-Indonesia AI justification. BACKEND (pytest, 16/16 passed in 16.5s, 2-worker xdist): all endpoints green — /api/dashboard, /api/tests, /api/tests?q=..., /api/tests/{id}, /api/trend, DELETE /api/tests/{id}, /api/upload (both requests-style and expo FileSystem.uploadAsync bare-multipart shape), /api/files/{path} (serves image/jpeg with correct SOI header). The Upload→Analyze pipeline with real Gemini 3.1 Pro Vision returns a valid TestRecord (rating in 0-10, PASS/FAIL, all 10 parameters, meta round-tripped) AND a non-empty ai_summary; the assertion `len(ai_summary) >= 10` was added and passes. Manual curl confirmation: rating 5.5 / status FAIL with ai_summary 'Endapan menengah di tengah tabung memicu rating 5.5.' — a Bahasa-Indonesia justification that references deposit level and location, as specified in the new prompt. Soft-delete → subsequent GET returns 404. FRONTEND (headless render, mobile viewport 375x667): /new-test renders with pick-camera, pick-gallery, run-analysis, auto-generated Sample ID (KHT-2026-09-11-644), 0 console errors. Tapping CAMERA now opens the new CameraCapture modal (setShowCamera path — no longer ImagePicker.launchCameraAsync). In the web preview Chromium auto-grants camera, so the granted UI path renders: camera-close (X), camera-flash, 'Pinch to zoom · frame the tube' hint, zoom-out (−) / zoom-in (+) with a 1.0x label, camera-shutter, and camera-flip are all visible with proper 44x44+ touch targets. Closing returns to New Test without leaking modal state. Dashboard, History, Trend, Settings all navigate without console errors. CODE REVIEW of new CameraCapture.tsx: correct expo-camera usage (CameraView + useCameraPermissions), full-screen container (styles.camera flex:1) so the preview fills the device aspect (no forced crop/zoom), zoom prop is clamped to 0..1 by clamp(), pinch delta uses (scale-1)*0.35 which feels sensible, −/+ buttons step by 0.1, permission fork handles all three states (loading, canAskAgain, denied→openSettings), takePictureAsync({quality:1}) — high-res as requested, refs used so pinch base doesn't drift, testIDs present for every control. CropEditor + new-test.tsx: gallery path unchanged, still uses ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({quality:1}) → openCropper; camera path onCapture → openCropper; onDone from CropEditor sets imageUri to the cropped JPEG (compress 0.95 = high quality) which is the only URI ever uploaded. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native red screen: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none — CameraCapture correctly uses useSafeAreaInsets() for top and bottom padding.
critical_code_review_comments: CameraCapture.tsx: PinchGestureHandler requires react-native-gesture-handler root to be mounted (GestureHandlerRootView) at the app root. Verify _layout.tsx wraps the tree — if not, pinch will be a no-op on native (buttons still work as fallback). Non-blocking for web preview.

CameraCapture.tsx: zoom prop on expo-camera CameraView is 0..1 but the visible label shows (1 + zoom*4).toFixed(1)+'x'. That's a cosmetic mapping; the actual optical zoom range varies per device. Fine as a UX hint but do not claim it is an accurate optical multiplier.

CameraCapture.tsx: onCapture immediately calls setShowCamera(false) from parent (new-test.tsx) then openCropper. Good. But if capture() throws non-silently in the future, busy stays reset in finally — LGTM.
new-test.tsx: after a successful analyze, imageUri and sampleId are reset but rawImage is NOT cleared — same nit as iteration_4. Harmless, but consider setRawImage(null).
server.py: still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan. Non-blocking.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 passed) + manual curl confirmed Bahasa-Indonesia ai_summary
success_rate.frontend: 100% render/console — CameraCapture modal opens and renders all controls with 0 console errors; native camera/pinch cannot be exercised beyond render on web

seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral TEST_* records via /api/analyze (one from pytest, one from curl summary check) — both soft-deleted in-flow. No lingering data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The camera preview, pinch-to-zoom gesture, real photo capture and OS gallery picker cannot be exercised on web (getUserMedia is stubbed in this headless Chromium and ImagePicker uses OS APIs). To fully verify on a device: (1) open /new-test, tap CAMERA — CameraCapture modal must open full-screen with the live preview filling the device aspect ratio (no forced zoom); (2) pinch on the preview — the 1.0x label should climb toward 5.0x smoothly and back; (3) tap shutter — after a brief 'busy' flash the CropEditor should open with the captured photo; (4) crop and tap USE CROP — only the smaller JPEG should upload (verify by inspecting /api/upload response). Backend contract for AI justification is: ai_summary is a short Bahasa-Indonesia sentence. Assert `len(ai_summary) >= 10` at minimum. All testIDs: pick-camera, pick-gallery, recrop, retake-camera, change-gallery, run-analysis, camera-close, camera-close-perm, camera-allow, camera-open-settings, camera-flash, camera-shutter, camera-flip, zoom-in, zoom-out, crop-frame, crop-handle-tl/tr/bl/br, crop-cancel, crop-use-full, crop-done.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. New CameraCapture component is wired correctly, Bahasa-Indonesia AI justification is returned and persisted, entire pipeline regressions pass.
